name: Vidra Hearthstove
summary: At Thelsamar’s Stoutlager Inn, Vidra Hearthstove cooks blood sausages with game from the surrounding wilderness.

sections.title: Kitchen of the Stoutlager
sections.body: Vidra keeps the inn supplied for locals and travelers. Like the innkeeper, she bears the Hearthstove name. Her blood sausages call for fresh game: boar entrails, spider ichor, and bear meat.

faq.answer: Vidra Hearthstove cooks at the Stoutlager Inn, where she lives. Patrons and Mountaineers defending Loch Modan are served her renowned Thelsamar blood sausages.

faq.q: Where can Vidra Hearthstove be found?
faq.answer: You can find Vidra inside the Stoutlager Inn, in the center of Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

faq.q: What ingredients does she use for Thelsamar Blood Sausages?
aliases: what is in thelsamar blood sausages
faq.answer: Vidra's famous recipe calls for bear meat, boar intestines, and spider ichor from wildlife in Loch Modan.

angles.text: As a cook, Vidra turns harsh local ingredients into sustaining meals for hungry adventurers and mountain patrols. Her cooking follows the hearty, rustic tradition of Khaz Modan.
As a dwarf passing through Thelsamar, you can find a comforting taste of home in Vidra's kitchen, where her cooking helps keep town morale high.
